Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Fixed the empty "Menu items order" and "Macros" screens.
• New sound theme "Nika iPhone" is the default sound theme.
• New gestures: shakes (one, two, long) and taps on the back (one, two, three) of the phone (Gestures, "Shake and back tap").
• Clock, Translator and Artificial intelligence moved to the "Apps" group; Gestures for apps moved to Gestures.
• Gemini settings moved to "Artificial intelligence".
• Per-app gestures: the list refreshes when you pick another app.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
